analyst.summary: Oberoi Realty is a premium Mumbai developer with an unusually strong, low-debt balance sheet and a substantial launch pipeline across prime micro-markets. Reported quarterly profit and revenue have swung sharply due to the normal timing of project completions in real estate accounting, but the more reliable demand indicator -- actual sales bookings -- grew only modestly this year. A large future capital raise has also been flagged by the company, which could involve issuing new shares. We rate this a Hold: a high-quality balance sheet and strong pipeline, but the recent growth numbers are noisier than they look, and a dilution event may be coming.
